project.name: NTR Common
project.description:
Shared infrastructure used by every NTR26 service. Cross-cutting utilities that sit BELOW the services layer in the dependency graph: services depend on ntr-common; ntr-common depends on nothing else in the project.
Current inhabitants: - com.mobileum.ntr.concurrent.NtrIdLock (ported-cpp) from RNS-NTR/cpp/IDLock.h - com.mobileum.ntr.config.NtrConfigReader (ported-cpp) from RNS-NTR/cpp/NTRCacheLibrary/NTRConfigReader.{h,cpp} - com.mobileum.ntr.config.ConfigSource (new) — pluggable backing-store interface
Future inhabitants (added as needs arise; resist creating sibling modules for individual concerns — see SPEC.md §5 + CLAUDE.md §12 rule 18): - com.mobileum.ntr.cache (L1+L2 cache abstraction) - com.mobileum.ntr.messaging (Kafka/IPCB producer-consumer wrappers) - com.mobileum.ntr.observability (OpenTelemetry + Prometheus setup) - com.mobileum.ntr.security (Vault integration)
